lecture_08.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 8: Parallelism basics
lecture_08.anchor_convention: lecture_08.pdf:p<page>, page numbers from `pdftotext -layout` form feeds (title slide = p1, 73 pages)
lecture_08.note: Evidence is the text layer of the slides (lecture_08.txt), extracted page-by-page by discover_slides.py (txt sha256 in discovered.json). Many numbers live only in pasted figures/tables with no text layer: the SuperPOD bisection-bandwidth table (p9), the GB200 NVL72 vs CloudMatrix 384 table (p12), the batch-size vs pipeline-depth throughput plot (p36), the activation-memory formulas' coefficients 34 and 24/t (p46-p47; only '5 as/h', '10 term', '4sbh', '2sbh' are text), the TPU-book batch-size plot (p56), the Narayanan 2021 scaling table (p59; only the DP-size column 32..6 is text), the PTD-P vs ZeRO-3 plot (p60), the (PP,TP) sweep plot (p61), the recomputation plot (p62) and the Llama 3 405B configuration table (p66). Those are recorded in filtering_notes as figure-only and are not used as answer keys unless the deck restates them in text (p59 notes, p61 caption, p72 table).

lecture_07.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 7: Parallelism (executable, Percy Liang)
lecture_07.note: Covers the same topic from the code side; see atlas/lectures/lecture_07/knowledge_points.json (16 KPs: interconnect-hierarchy, collective-taxonomy, all-gather, reduce-scatter, all-reduce-decomposition, all-to-all, rdma-nccl, torch-distributed-setup, benchmark-method, collective-bytes, data-parallelism-ddp, zero-sharding, tensor-parallelism, pipeline-sharding, pipeline-bubble, parallelism-axes). Referenced only through external_prerequisites (lecture_07:<kp-id>). This deck adds what the executable lecture does not: the bandwidth hierarchy between GPUs/nodes, communication/compute ratios per parallelism type, ZeRO stages 1-3 vs FSDP accounting, activation memory under TP/SP, expert/context parallelism, the 3D-parallelism recipe and what recent LMs actually run.
